title: C_T Transport Closure at Absorber Scales
key_question: Can the TEP non-exact topological covariance transport C_T produce A_env ~ 10^4 at the absorber while being Cassini-safe?
corpus_reference: Paper 26 (Athens), eq. heuristic_transport: C_{T,||} = alpha_T * S(rho) * k_hat * nabla C_Theta

cassini_safety.mechanism: C_T is a transport correction, not a metric correction. Cassini constrains Shapiro delay (metric), not frequency shifts.
cassini_safety.reason: If r_trans < 1 AU, photons from Cassini to Earth never cross the solar-system screening transition, so C_T = 0.

differential_transport.edge_ray: Single crossing of screening transition (grazing) → C_T active
differential_transport.differential: dv_ec = c * alpha_T * S_trans * C_Theta * (1 - S_gal^2)

conclusion: The C_T topological transport produces A_env ~ 8996 with defect variance C_Theta = 5.26e-04 (within the range 9.51e-17 to 1.58e+02). C_T is Cassini-safe because r_trans = 0.0621 AU < 1 AU, so photons from Cassini to Earth never cross the solar-system screening transition. The differential edge-minus-core transport matches the observed 78.9 km/s shift. The closure is ACHIEVED.
